verdict.rationale: Obsidian has dedicated developer docs (obsidian-developer-docs) with a documented plugin API (Vault interface on GitHub), a step-by-step 'Build a plugin' tutorial with sample plugin source code to compile and load, and guidance on building TypeScript plugins and CSS themes. Community evidence corroborates an active plugin ecosystem (Bases, Relay, Self-Hosted LiveSync, Copilot plugins) built by third parties using this API. Missing for 10: more extensive first-party sample gallery/reference docs beyond the single tutorial and independent developer testimonials on API completeness/quality.
